title: Scaling a recipe by 15 ÷ 6 = 2.5
caption: Fifteen people is 2.5 lots of six, so every amount is multiplied by 2.5: 450 g of flour becomes 1,125 g.
alt: Two bars on the same scale: 450 g for 6 people, and 450 g + 450 g + 225 g = 1,125 g for 15 people.
description: The top bar is the flour for 6 people, 450 g.
The lower bar is two whole copies of it and a half copy: 450 + 450 + 225.
That is 450 × 2.5 = 1,125 g, the flour for 15 people.
